g.text: +allocate(resourceId: String, session: UserSession, mode: AccessMode): ResourceLease
ASR-002: Primary control plane; observing mode commands mediated.
ASR-008/FR-038: All critical resources via allocator; deadlock-free required.
ASR-009/FR-040/NFR-024: Sustain 200Hz bursts; isolated from control path.
ASR-012/NFR-012: Initiate safe-state <=2s; confirm <=10s; interlocks independent.
NFR-006: Privileges at login; 12+ char password; auto-logout 30min inactivity; privilege changes audited.
NFR-001: Accept/reject within 2s (99.9%); no execution before ACK.
ASR-011/NFR-005: 2-3ms access; async writes; EPICS in IOC.
